_comment: The Odoo image this repository tests its bridge client against.
Pinned by digest so the compatibility lane answers a fixed question: does
this client still work against that provider. A tag would let the answer
change without any commit here, which is the opposite of what a
mb-infra overrides it when composing a release with a new image
combination, which is the case this cannot cover: a candidate Odoo that
does not exist yet when this pin is written.
Raise it deliberately, after the lane passes against the new digest.
